scope: I0B0 only; existing rounds 0,24,48,72; no time integration
basins: four-neighbor wet surface connectivity, periodic longitude and closed latitude; wet columns share surface wet depth; order by descending fixed area, deterministic tie by label
area: dx_2d * manifest dy; wet-mask only; volume=sum(area*(eta-eta_t0)); mean=volume/sum(area)
regions: latitude [-66,-58),[-58,-30),[-30,30),[30,66); longitude quadrants [0,90),[90,180),[180,270),[270,360); report signed positive and negative volumes independently
reference: historical linear EOS, zero anomaly pressure at global z=0; masked trapezoidal density-anomaly integration at original dz_3d; surface pressure=rho0*g*eta; average forces using original dz_norm, never gradient of column-mean pressure
oracle: independent NumPy cumulative pressure and common-wet spherical face-gated gradient versus frozen historical JAX operators; constant 1m pressure gauge shift must leave force unchanged within arithmetic tolerance
tolerances: 4096*float64 eps: volume bound times max(1,sum(abs(area*delta_eta))); pressure bound times max(1,max(abs(P))); force bound times max(1,max(abs(P)),rho0*g)*max(inv_dx,inv_dy/min(cos_lat))/rho0. These are prospective postprocessing arithmetic checks, not physical qualification or original integration gates.
dynamics: report pressure forces separately from Coriolis and pressure+Coriolis; coarse fixed-node column-velocity differences over 7200s are interval Eulerian accelerations, not instantaneous residuals or proof of geostrophic equilibrium; advection, diffusion, wind, friction not ablated
publication: portable script and aggregate scalars/hashes only; no private arrays, source files or personal paths
correction: 296 retained points are a subset, not the full wet domain. Previous 85-89m3 six-hour ledger bound was a posthoc arithmetic supplement, never a preregistered scientific acceptance gate.
